Stock market news | Adani Airport Holdings raises $300 million from 360 ONE Asset

On 23 November 2026, Adani Airport Holdings raised $300 million (₹2,790 crore) from 360 ONE Asset, bringing total equity infusion to $1.35 billion.

The capital will be used to modernize existing airport infrastructure, create Airport Cities, and grow passenger-facing and non-aeronautical businesses, supporting the goal to lift passenger capacity to 200 million.
